# The repositories that run inspector-gate and are kept in step with this
# one. .github/workflows/gate-sync.yml opens or updates one pull request on
# each of them whenever either gate file changes on main - see
# .github/scripts/gate-sync.sh and README's "Syncing the gate to other
# repositories".
#
# One "owner/repo" per line. Blank lines and "#" comments are ignored.
# Everything else is read strictly: a line that is not an owner/repo pair, a
# repository named twice, or this repository naming itself fails the whole
# run before any consumer is touched. This file decides where a token with
# write access to other people's repositories gets pointed, so acting on half
# of an ambiguous list is worse than refusing all of it.
#
# Adding a repository here is only half of onboarding it: GATE_SYNC_TOKEN must
# also be scoped to it, with Contents and Pull requests write access, or the
# first sync fails closed naming it.
inactdev/dotfiles
